Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on laser-capture microdissected (LCM) glomeruli, interstitial tissue, and liver tissue. While the material was spatially isolated via LCM, the subsequent processing involved total lysis (SDS lysis buffer, sonication, heating) and trypsin digestion of the resulting extract, which constitutes a whole cell lysate of those specific micro-dissected regions rather than a purified protein complex or a specific organelle subproteome.
